checkpoint_note: The 17:59 clean checkpoint strengthens/qualifies C1-C7 but does not mint additional candidate IDs; classifications remain candidate-ID based and preserve the newer evidence as provenance.

assessments.mechanism: Evaluate self-improvement as experience/signal→reusable procedure→routing/activation→held-out uptake, explicitly measuring negative transfer.
assessments.clean_scope: EvoAgentBench 2026. Qwen3.5-27B vanilla37.5, Memento35.1, ReasoningBank41.1, GEPA38.7, curated Anchor45.0; every automatic method has at least one negative setting. Anchor uses curator-side ability labels and is diagnostic/oracle-like, not deployable automation.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly scopes Candidates, protected held-out boundaries and routing/context experiments, so the transfer/routing problem is known; no EvoAgentBench mechanism/effect is directly evaluated.

assessments.mechanism: Treat autonomous meta-agent self-improvement as high-variance; require run-variance controls, held-out verification and policy/reward-hacking audits.
assessments.clean_scope: Meta-Agent Challenge proxy evidence for recursive self-improvement; substantial configuration/run variance and policy violations.
assessments.uncertainty: Proxy benchmark does not establish general recursive self-improvement dynamics.
assessments.o_comparison: O has conservative Candidate/regression and evidence boundaries but no MAC-style autonomous meta-agent benchmark, run-variance analysis or zero-resource red-team study.

assessments.mechanism: Two-timescale evolution of task skills and the improver/meta-skills themselves.
assessments.clean_scope: MetaSkill-Evolve/HSI-style held-out evidence; HSI DeepSeek-V4-Flash average 18.9 initial→33.1 meta-off→41.4 meta-on, with meta gains varying from +0.2 NLE to +19.0 TextWorld. Exact MetaSkill marginal slow-loop/component ablations remain incomplete in the clean base candidate.
assessments.uncertainty: Meta-improvement benefit is signal/headroom dependent and does not rescue near-zero-signal regimes.
assessments.o_comparison: No explicit fast task-skill plus slow analyzer/retriever/allocator/proposer/evolver meta-skill evolution loop was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Keep persistent improvement in a curated external knowledge substrate while agent/model instances remain resettable/disposable.
assessments.clean_scope: KSI/persistent-object design plus later GDPevo/BaT context; exact KSI quantitative cells still have primary-table verification limits.
assessments.uncertainty: Persistent substrate design is not evidence that any particular distillation substrate generalizes.
assessments.o_comparison: O already treats repository state, Episodes/Candidates/evidence and continuation as durable while model/session context can reset; it has not implemented KSI claim/forum/distillation substrate.

assessments.mechanism: Give an improver selective access to raw execution traces because compressed scores/summaries may destroy diagnostic signal.
assessments.clean_scope: Meta-Harness raw-trace ablation/held-out transfer; later AHE self-attribution shows predicted regression precision/recall only 11.8%/11.1%, reinforcing the value of empirical traces/gates rather than self-report.
assessments.uncertainty: TerminalBench specialization is weaker broad-generalization evidence; raw traces can increase context/cost.
assessments.o_comparison: O persists detailed invocation/tool events alongside compact Episodes/continuation, so the design premise is known; no matched raw-trace versus summary-only self-improvement ablation exists.

assessments.mechanism: Bound self-improvement edits to one coherent component and accept only when train improves without hidden-development regression.
assessments.clean_scope: AutoDesign domain plus AHE 2026 component evidence. AHE seed69.7; memory-only75.3 (+5.6), tool-only73.0, middleware71.9, system-prompt-only67.4 (-2.3), full77.0; hard-task memory-only63.3 > full53.3, showing coupled changes can interfere. AHE frozen SWE transfer is only +0.4pp pass@1 though tokens fall ~12%.
assessments.uncertainty: No direct one-component-vs-multicomponent causal ablation for AutoDesign; AHE is harness-specific.
assessments.o_comparison: O Candidates are scoped/reversible, protected by exact-head/regression validation and inactive before acceptance, so bounded proposal/no-regression is partially implemented; no hidden-dev proposer separation or one-component edit loop matching the candidate is evaluated.

assessments.mechanism: Use strict held-out selection plus a safe empty/base fallback for evolving natural-language/procedural state; reject harmful candidates rather than accumulate them.
assessments.clean_scope: RSEA transfer evidence plus newer harness-evolution cautions. Disjoint harness study initial67.7 vs evolved68.3 (+0.6) on held-out, while with unit tests direct/parallel/sequential often beat harness evolution; repeated held-out reuse can itself overfit.
assessments.uncertainty: Guarantee is only for held-out validation distribution; small/adaptively reused validation sets weaken it.
assessments.o_comparison: O has protected baseline regression, reversible Candidate activation, retained base components and fresh held-out/independent boundaries; the active recursive-routing experiment currently has a frozen pending request but no result, so exact natural-language-state evolution is not evaluated.
